name: Pedalmoto
description: Bicycle shop from Granada with an online store on PrestaShop. Sells bicycles, e-bikes, components, clothing, helmets, accessories and nutrition. Its delivery page states free shipping thresholds for the Peninsula, Balearic Islands and Portugal and says shipping outside the Peninsula is quoted on request.
description_es: Tienda de bicicletas de Granada con tienda online en PrestaShop. Vende bicicletas, bicicletas eléctricas, componentes, ropa, cascos, accesorios y nutrición. Su página de entrega indica envío gratis desde cierto importe en Península, Baleares y Portugal y que fuera de la península el envío se cotiza bajo consulta.

ships_to.notes: Delivery page lists the Peninsula and the Balearic Islands; shipping outside the Peninsula is not calculated automatically and is quoted on request.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: A shop address in Granada is shown; in-store pickup is not stated.
